<translate>
<!--T:1-->
DragonMineZ adds five dimensions on top of the vanilla Overworld, which the mod treats as [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. Each world has its own purpose: mining and Namekian villages on [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]], extreme-gravity training in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Hyperbolic Time Chamber|Hyperbolic Time Chamber]], death and revival in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld|Otherworld]], and the stacked worlds of Dragon Ball Daima in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]]. Most of them are reached with the [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]].
</translate>

<div class="dmz-cards">
{{Card|Earth|<translate><!--T:2--> The Overworld: masters' homes, Kami's Lookout, Turles and the Earth Dragon Balls.</translate>}}
{{Card|Namek|<translate><!--T:3--> The Namekian home world: a full mining world, Frieza's army and the Big Gete Star.</translate>}}
{{Card|Sacred Kai Planet|<translate><!--T:4--> The lush world of the Kais and home of Old Kai.</translate>}}
{{Card|Hyperbolic Time Chamber|<translate><!--T:5--> An endless white void with ten times the normal gravity, built for training.</translate>}}
{{Card|Otherworld|<translate><!--T:6--> The afterlife: spirits, King Kai's Planet, Hell and the Otherworld Tournament.</translate>}}
{{Card|Demon Realm|<translate><!--T:7--> Three stacked Demon Worlds ruled by King Gomah.</translate>}}
</div>

<translate>
== Travelling between worlds == <!--T:26-->
</translate>
{{See also|Space Pod|Space Pod Destinations}}
<translate>
<!--T:27-->
The [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]] is the main way to travel between worlds. Its menu lists every destination; each one has its own unlock rule (a story quest, a sidequest or a server setting). Locked destinations stay in the list, greyed out, so you can see what is still ahead.
</translate>

{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:28--> Destination</translate> !! <translate><!--T:29--> Unlocks when</translate> !! <translate><!--T:30--> Where you land</translate>
|-
| {{L|Earth}} || <translate><!--T:31--> Always</translate> || <translate><!--T:32--> Same X, Y and Z as you</translate>
|-
| {{L|Namek}} || <translate><!--T:33--> Always</translate> || <translate><!--T:34--> Same X, Y and Z as you</translate>
|-
| {{L|Otherworld}} || <translate><!--T:35--> The Otherworld is enabled on the server and you completed Bulma's ''Otherworld Drive'' sidequest</translate> || 54, 210, 1082
|-
| {{L|Sacred Kai Planet}} || <translate><!--T:36--> You completed Buu Saga quest 23, ''Gotenks at Full Power''</translate> || <translate><!--T:37--> Same X, Y and Z as you</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:38--> Time Chamber</translate> || <translate><!--T:39--> You completed Bulma's ''Temporal Comm-Link'' sidequest</translate> || 0.5, 130, 0.5
|-
| {{L|Demon Realm}} || <translate><!--T:40--> You completed Daima Saga quest 3, ''To the Demon Realm''</translate> || 160.5, 745, 0.5
|}

<translate>
<!--T:41-->
The menu shows up to seven destinations at once. Two more entries, '''Cereal Planet''' and '''Beerus Planet''', appear greyed out but never unlock in DragonMineZ on its own: they are reserved for add-on dimensions. Server owners and add-ons can add their own destinations with a datapack (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod Destinations|Space Pod Destinations]]).
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:42-->
Other ways to move around:
* '''Death''': when the Otherworld is enabled, dying sends your spirit to the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld|Otherworld]] instead of respawning you.
* '''Portals''': the Time Chamber portal at [[Special:MyLanguage/Kami's Lookout|Kami's Lookout]] takes you into the [[Special:MyLanguage/Hyperbolic Time Chamber|Hyperbolic Time Chamber]] and back.
* '''Finding structures''': {{Command|/dmzlocate &lt;structure&gt;}} finds DragonMineZ structures in the dimension you are in (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Finding structures|Structures]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Gravity == <!--T:54-->
</translate>
{{Config|Gravity Config|gravityPerWorld}}
<translate>
<!--T:55-->
Every world has a base [[Special:MyLanguage/Gravity|gravity]]. By default all DragonMineZ worlds use normal gravity (×1.0) except the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, which uses ×10. The [[Special:MyLanguage/Sacred Kai Planet|Sacred Kai Planet]] and the Demon Realm aren't listed in the per-world gravity setting, so they use the fallback value, also ×1.0. Server owners can change all of these.
</translate>
